Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
1. Request is made on behalf of counsel for respondent no.2 for an accommodation, since parties are not available to be present in the Court today.

2. This petition is filed seeking quashing of FIR No.114/2019 under Sections 498A/406/34 IPC registered at PS Bhalswa Dairy on the basis of settlement arrived at between the parties on 22nd January 2024.
4. Order be uploaded on the website of this Court.
